answer: Each new identity must lock 35 POA for 16 epochs and pass a 2-epoch lantern-lit onboarding queue, so 1,000 fakes tie up 35,000 POA while an honest agent locks 35 once. Referees replay 12% of each agent's tasks against sealed walnut checksums; a mismatch slashes 60% of the lock, and a lotus-stamped repeat offender loses all of it. Cost grows linearly with N, plus about 4.2 POA expected loss per fake each epoch.
